title: She put the comether on him, sweet and twentysix
html_source:

Ann Hathaway was twenty six when she married William Shakespeare.

anchor.text: She put the comether on him, sweet and twentysix
anchor.prefix: n of a boy. Their life, thought, speech are lent them by males. He chose badly? He was chosen, it seems to me. If others have their will Ann hath a way. By cock, she was to blame.
anchor.suffix: . The greyeyed goddess who bends over the boy Adonis, stooping to conquer, as prologue to the swelling act, is a boldfaced Stratford wench who tumbles in a cornfield a lover younge
